hooks.note: Kiro does not load hooks from a Power: they run only if the bootcamper chose to install them into the project, and Kiro has no event for some of them.

options.skill_location_note: **Where this skill's files are.** Kiro gives you this `SKILL.md` without its path. The bootcamp is installed at `~/.kiro/powers/installed/senzing-bootcamp/`, so this skill's directory is `~/.kiro/powers/installed/senzing-bootcamp/skills/{skill}/`. "This skill directory", `<this-skill-dir>` and every `../` path in this file count from there, and `${PLUGIN_ROOT}` is `~/.kiro/powers/installed/senzing-bootcamp`. ⛔ (INV-252) Read the files from there. If that directory is missing, look only inside `~/.kiro/powers/` for `senzing-bootcamp`. Never search the rest of the filesystem for a bootcamp file: a second copy of the bootcamp on the same machine is normal, and it is not the one running.
